note: SECURITY_AUDIT.md F74 -- every panic site that survives into the SHIPPED wasm engine, with the
reading that says it cannot be reached from a door. Generated and graded by
scripts/keys/f74-wasm-panic-sites.py; `--check` fails on any site not in this file.
WHY IT EXISTS. F74's ceiling was a list derived from the artifact and adjudicated by hand in
docs/security-audit-findings.md -- correct, and load-bearing on nothing: no check failed if a
later edit turned one of the readings false, and the census had to be re-run by whoever
remembered. This file is that reading committed, so the next engine rebuild grades itself.
THE KEY IS (file, text), NOT (file, line). F74 carries two stale-anchor corrections in five days
and concludes that a finding should anchor on a symbol rather than a line. An unrelated edit
above a site shifts its line; a gate that reds on that is a gate somebody turns off. The text of
the expression is what was adjudicated, so an edit to the expression is what forces a re-reading.
`line` and `column` are the last observed coordinates, carried for the reader, and are not graded.
`count` is how many Location records share one (file, text) -- two `it.next().unwrap()` on one
line are two sites, and two identically-written `group[group.len() - 1]` in one file are two.
THE CLASSES. `invariant`: total by an invariant in its own function, a guard above it, or the
type. `loader`: total by a guarantee the dataset loader enforces and states. `rule1-const`:
deliberate Rule-1 loudness over a const compiled into the binary -- reachable by a build-time
defect, never by a caller. A site that fits none of the three is not a fourth class; it is a
finding, and F74 reopens.
WHAT A GREEN HERE DOES NOT SAY. Most of these readings rest on a guard somewhere ELSE in the
function -- appliers/defense.rs's is a two-step argument over guards thirty lines up. Break that
guard without touching the indexing line and this file still grades clean. The floor,
crates/coh_wasm/tests/panic_freedom.rs, is what covers that direction by driving the doors with
mutated builds. Neither artifact alone is F74's argument.
